submitted.rationale: XRD shows a rutile-type InSbO4 phase at every point measured. Bixbyite In2O3 appears alongside it on the In-rich side and fades by about 50% Sb. The Sb-rich end shows only a weak extra peak. EQE rose with Sb content: 0.00055% at idx 4, 0.0068% at idx 18 and 0.0075% at idx 25. Index 25 was the highest of the three measured.
